verdict.rationale: Column's docs say its API is defined by an OpenAPI spec that is also available as JSON. A live probe confirmed a downloadable openapi.json (HTTP 200, containing the "openapi" key). Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of the spec's completeness and accuracy for codegen.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Column's API is defined by an OpenAPI spec (also available as JSON). Use it to generate type-safe client SDKs in any language
